title: Bohol International Marathon 2026 Review: A Full Marathon on Panglao Island
seo_title: Bohol Marathon 2026 Review | Panglao Philippines Race Guide
meta_description: The Bohol International Marathon 2026: August 30 on Panglao Island, Bohol. 42K, 21K, 10K, 5K with registration open — a Chocolate Hills destination marathon.
dek: Set for 30 August 2026 on Panglao Island, Bohol, this marathon offers four distances with registration open. A full marathon on the island famous for the Chocolate Hills and tarsier sanctuaries.
verdict: The Bohol International Marathon brings a full 42.195km to Panglao Island — Bohol's premier beach destination, connected to the main island by bridge and home to world-class dive sites and white-sand beaches. Four distances (42K, 21K, 10K, 5K) with registration open. Bohol itself is one of the Philippines' top destinations: the Chocolate Hills, the tarsier sanctuary, and the Loboc River cruise make for possibly the best post-race recovery in the country. August is the tail of the wet season in the Visayas. For runners wanting an island marathon with genuine tourism appeal, this is a standout Philippine pick.

sections.heading: Panglao: Bohol's Beach Paradise
paragraphs: Panglao Island is one of the Philippines' premier beach destinations — connected to Bohol by bridge, with white-sand beaches, world-class diving, and easy access to the Chocolate Hills. [1] A full marathon here combines road racing with one of the country's best tourism infrastructures. Registration is open.
